breadcrumb.name: What is the Procedure for Obtaining a Dubai Work Remote Visa?

contentHtml:
The UAE cabinet approved the ‘Dubai Remote Work Visa’, or ‘Virtual Nomad Visa’ in early January 2021. This new type of Visa program will permit all individuals employed overseas to acquire a working resident visa to allow them to live in the UAE.

In this article, you will learn everything about remote work visa in Dubai and the procedure for obtaining it. Therefore, make sure to read the important information about all the processes and the documents required to obtain the visa and how much it costs. Let’s observe:

 

How do I obtain a Dubai Work Remote Visa?

This big step, the first of its kind in the region, will provide entrepreneurs and skilled workers the opportunity to innovate in the UAE. Firstly, you must apply through the ‘Visit Dubai Visa’ portal to obtain the Dubai Work Remote Visa. Secondly, the program grants its applicants all the services that residents of the UAE benefit from utilities to schooling.

 

Once you are on the ‘Visit Dubai Visa’ portal these are the basic steps you must do:

STEP 1: Apply for the Dubai Work Remote Visa – fulfil the basic personal information such as full name, email address, and mobile phone number.

STEP 2: Submit the documents – in order to check, if you meet the requirements, you must submit the necessary documents we will mention below.

STEP 3: Get the Dubai Work Remote Visa – if your remote work visa application gets the approval you will receive it quickly since the site is connected to the portal is connected to the UAE Immigration authorities.

 

Documents Required for Dubai Work Remote Visa?

 

In order to apply for the Virtual Nomad Visa, you will need to provide the following documents in high resolution:

 

    1. Current Valid Passport: (6 months of validity minimum)
    2. UAE Health Insurance: Local Health Insurance or Travel Insurance covering UAE.

 

For Employees: Minimum of one-year validity and proof of employment from your current employer. Minimum income of $5,000 per month, with payslip from 3 last months and bank statements from the previous 3 months.

For Business Owners: Minimum of one-year ownership of the company, Minimum monthly income of $5,000, and bank statements from the previous 3 months.

 

How much does the Dubai Work Remote Visa cost?

The overall fee set by the government for the Visa is AED 2,300 ($620). This fee includes the processing and the costs from the Dubai Immigration for the 1-year visa. Certainly, all the renewal costs for the Visa for a 2-year period are the same as the previously mentioned; AED 2,300 ($620) each year.

Likewise, the payment of the fee will not guarantee its approval. Subsequently, the fees and process time may change depending on the country of citizenship, what application service is required, and if you are applying whether from the UAE or from overseas.

Certainly, the fee does not include any health insurance costs, therefore, the applicant will need to organize by themselves as part of the overall process. The health insurance costs will depend on different factors; like age and health conditions.

In conclusion, if the application needs to get qualification documents, notarized legalized documents, or proof of employment, the individual will have to cover the total costs of the attestation process since the previously mentioned fee DO NOT include any of the foreign documents.

 

Is the work remote visa just available in Dubai?

Yes, at the moment this is Visa is only available in the Dubai Zone. Likewise, there are plenty of freelancer options in Abu Dhabi, Dubai, and the UAE Free zones.

Firstly, the one-year Remote Work Visa is renewable upon re-application, therefore, all individuals can get all the services a resident of the UAE would have. For instance, remote work in Dubai (working from home) has plenty of advantages, one of which is that you will not pay income tax.

Most importantly, with this visa, you receive all the money you earn while working in Dubai. And since you will earn your income tax-free you could experience an increase in your take-home pay, you will expand your savings capacity, plan a vacation, and many more due to the tax-free policy.

 

What are the minimum salary criteria for Dubai visa requirements, and so on?

 

    • For Employees:

 

 

    1. Proof of employment
    2. Salary certificate
    3. Minimum of $5000 monthly income.

 

 

    • For Business:

 

 

    1. Proof of +1-year ownership of the organization
    2. Minimum of $5,000 monthly income
    3. Bank statements from the last 3 months.

 

The Dubai Tourism Authority and Immigration is the commissioned body and they review all and process all the applications, that is to say, they decide the approval of the application.

 

Is the minimum wage pre-tax or post-tax?

The total monthly income required is $5000 (USD), therefore, that is the total amount after all deductions.

 

How long does the Dubai Remote Working Visa take to set up?

 

    • Entry Permit Charges:  +10 working days approximately.
    • Visa change of status: 4 to 6 working days.
    • Medical Screening tests: 1 day.
    • Emirates ID biometrics: +2 Days approximately.
    • Processing the residence Visa: +10 working days approximately.

 

 

What are the requirements for health insurance?

The health insurance in the UAE must have coverage validity, or health coverage with travel insurance (minimum 2-week validity), consequently, once your visa process has been completed the applicant can change it to the UAE health insurance.

 

Is it possible for a Dubai Remote Work Visa holder to sponsor his or her dependents?

Yes. The Remote Visa holder can always sponsor their dependents/family, but they will need to rent a proper space in the UAE in order to do so.

 

If I already have a UAE residency visa, may I put my dependents visa on hold?

 

In addition, according to the Department of Tourism and Commerce Marketing (DTCM), the applicant cannot. As a result, you would have to cancel your previous process and re-apply for the Remote Work Visa. On the other hand, in order to be eligible for the Remote Work Visa, you must provide payslips for a period of two months as well from your employer overseas.

 

Are there any nationality restrictions?

Everyone can apply for the Work Remote/Nomad Visa since there is no restrictions base on nationality. However, the application process can be rejected due to National Security.

 

Duration of the visa

The Dubai Remote Work Visa is valid for 1 full year, as a result, it is also renewable each year with the same application process.

 

How is my income taxed using the Dubai work remote visa?

The applicant to obtain the UAE Tax Residency Certificate using this Remote Work Visa program. In the UAE all personal and corporate income tax is at 0%. However, depending on plenty of factors such as how many days you physically reside in the UAE and other countries; the tax regime will differ considerably. You can contact us and one of our experts will advise you on your global income and taxes.

One of the main benefits of this program means that all approved applicants of the visa will absolutely benefit from the UAE’s policy of zero income tax on their overseas salary.

 

How frequently do I need to visit the UAE to keep my visa valid?

In order to keep your visa valid, you need to visit the UAE at least ONCE every 6 months.

 

Is it necessary for the applicant to be in the UAE?

The applicant needs to be in the UAE to apply for the Dubai Remote Work Visa program due to travel restrictions. Meanwhile, he can travel in as a tourist, and then he/she could change the status to the Work Remote Visa.

 

Is it possible for a Dubai Remote Working Visa holder to create a bank account in the UAE?

Basically, yes. The Remote work visa provides all the applicants the ability to reside in Dubai just like a resident would:

 

    • Access to phone lines.
    • Resident ID cards.
    • Banking Facilities.
    • Send their children to school.
    • Rent or buy properties.

 

 

Advantages of the Dubai Remote Work Visa

Before when the visa program was approved, individuals who wanted to work in Dubai must have an existing employment contract or a business license outside the United Arab Emirates, on the other hand, since January 2021 it will be otherwise.

Subsequently, with the Remote Work Visa individuals are able to work from the UAE for their previous employer with almost no restrictions.

Most importantly, every individual working for an organization overseas can come to the UAE and keep their job, moreover, they can reside and work in the Dubai area while you enjoy the high-quality of life here.

Advantages of the Dubai Remote Work visa:

 

    • Enter the UAE under self-sponsorship
    • Work in the UAE.
    • Live in the UAE.
    • Gain access to all the UAE premium standard services (utilities, telecoms, schooling, etc)
    • Get an Emirates ID.
    • Sponsor your wife and children.

 

Above all, people who live and work outside the UAE, start-ups and entrepreneurs are eligible if they meet the criteria. Further, the individual can bring his/her family if the process to live In Dubai is approved.

The world is quickly changing, there is more and more remote work every day, as a result, Dubai offers a safe space to remote workers in an income tax-free jurisdiction.

 

How can Connect Group help you obtain a remote work visa?

 

Here in Connect Group, we want to help you reach your personal goals by relocating you to the UAE. If you decide to contact us, we will assist you throughout the entire process of getting the Dubai Remote Work Visa. Moreover, we have a team of specialists ready to answer your inquiries about the visa process.

We have other services that will ensure to benefit your company’s growth. Therefore, you may want to improve your HR department using our cloud HR services, you can request HR consultancy, insurance, or our attendance.

We can set you up so you can start residing and working in one of the top destinations of the world.

If you have any inquiries, call us on +97143316688 and you will talk to one of our representatives who will answer all of your questions and inquiries.
